newsitem.title: UK: CIA says positioned to become global player.
newsitem.headline: CIA says positioned to become global player.

text.p: CIA Group Plc, Europe's second largest independent media buyer, on Thursday reported 1996 turnover rose 28 percent and said it believes it is positioned to become a major global player in the next few years.

Turnover for 1996 rose to 773.8 million pounds from 606.4 million pounds in 1995. Pre-tax profits rose 12 percent to 7.5 million pounds, excluding exceptional charges of 2.6 million pounds, from 6.7 million pounds in 1995. The charges included two million pounds related to a settlment with certain TV broadcasters in the UK.
"We believe we now have in place all the ingredients necessary to become a major global player in the next few years," chairman Chris Ingram said in a statement.

"It is for this reason that we have set ourselves the target of being in the world's top six buyers of media -- including all advertising agencies and specialist media companies -- within the next four years," he said.
